No genuine mid-gesture instant with target/duration/progress exists anywhere in the candidate's event trail.

The candidate performed exactly ONE atomic dragByKey (a no-op, kind=touch) and one shoot; there is no second during-gesture capture and no legible target-position value in any candidate during-capture (the sole shot shows the folder path unchanged). No two data points of differing magnitude/direction exist to show the feedback tracks the swipe.

Seek commits to the last-shown target. Cited post bundle has runtime lens; a separate rightward swipe from 61s->82s also confirmed forward commit.

The during-gesture screenshot deliverable was captured immediately AFTER a single atomic dragByKey (no incremental updates, no real elapsed time, drag moved nothing), and the image shows the resting folder-path bottom line -- a near-duplicate of the post-gesture shot. It is not traceable to any capture taken while a gesture was genuinely in flight; it matches the recorded field-test failure of a during-screenshot that disproves the claim it supports.

My own post-gesture XTEST screenshot (settled) shows the bottom line back to the folder path '~' with the jump icon, no seek readout and no center indicator -- a genuinely later, settled capture distinct from the during state. Corroborates the candidate's own post shot content.

Structural read in the same settled bundle -- semantics SemanticsNode#9 = '~ / jump to now-playing folder' and inspect playback (isPlaying true, position committed) -- independently corroborates the post-gesture screenshot's revert to the folder path.

All three hero-surface tap zones still work via real on-screen taps: NEXT zone advanced currentIndex 0->1, PREV zone 1->0 (3-track queue), and center play-pause toggled isPlaying true->false->true.
